wallets_header: THOLA ISIKHWAMA SE-BITCOIN SAMAHHALA UKUZE WAMUKELE IZINKOKHELO ZE-BITCOIN
wallets_intro_1: Zonke izikhwama ze-Bitcoin ziyasebenzisana, ngakho amakhasimende akho angakukhokha nge-Bitcoin noma ngabe asebenzisa siphi isikhwama.
wallets_intro_3: Lezi yizikhwama ze-Bitcoin ezimsulwa ezivula zonke izinzuzo ze-Bitcoin: akukho baphakathi, izimali eziphansi, futhi akukho ukubuyiswa kwemali noma ukukhohliswa.
wallets_intro_5: Lezi zikuvumela ukushintshanisa noma iyiphi ingxenye ye-Bitcoin yakho ngamadola ngokushesha lapho ikhasimende likukhokha. Izimali zisaphansi kunanezinkokhelo zamakhadi esikweletu, kodwa ziphezulu kunanezinkokhelo ze-Bitcoin ezimsulwa.
wallets_intro_6: Zombili ziyizindlela ezinhle zokwamukela i-Bitcoin. Isikhwama esithile osisebenzisayo sizoncika ebukhulwini nohlobo lwebhizinisi lakho.
wallets_square_note: Ungamukela izinkokhelo ze-Bitcoin ngetheminali yakho ekhona ye-Square PoS noma ukuhlanganiswa kwesitolo saku-inthanethi. Akukaze kube lula kangaka ukwamukela izinkokhelo ze-Bitcoin.
wallets_hero_subtitle: Izikhwama ze-Bitcoin zimahhala. Khetha esihambelana nebhizinisi lakho — phambili komuntu, online, noma esekelwe ezi-invoyisi — futhi uqale ukwamukela i-Bitcoin ngemizuzu.
wallets_section_sole_intro: Uma uphethe isitolo, ikhefi, isitudiyo, noma insizakalo wedwa, noma yisiphi salezi zikhwama sizosebenza. Khetha kusekelwe ekutheni ufuna ukugcina izinkokhelo nge-Bitcoin noma ushintshele ngokuzenzakalelayo ingxenye yenkokhelo nganye eye kumali yakho yendawo.
wallets_section_multiple_intro: Uma uneqembu elithatha izinkokhelo emshinini wokukhokha, khetha isikhwama esivumela ukungena kwabasebenzi abaningi — ngakho wonke umsebenzi uthola i-PIN yakhe futhi ugcine umkhondo ohlanzekile wokuhlola wokuthi ngubani othathe yiphi inkokhelo.
wallets_section_online_intro: Uthengisa kuwebhusayithi? Lezi zikhwama ziyaxhumana esitolo sakho se-online futhi zamukela i-Bitcoin kunoma yiliphi ikhasimende, kunoma kuphi emhlabeni — akukho kubuyiselwa, akudingeki i-akhawunti yomthengisi.
wallets_section_invoice_intro: Uma uthumela izi-invoyisi kumakhasimende (ukucebisa, ukusebenza ngokuzimela, izinsizakalo ze-B2B), sebenzisa isikhwama esakhelwe ekuthumeleni izi-invoyisi. Ikhasimende lakho likhokha i-invoyisi ye-Bitcoin ngokuchofoza okumbalwa.
wallets_strike_note: I-Strike Business ikuvumela ukwamukela izinkokhelo ze-Bitcoin ne-Lightning ngezimali ezingu-zero futhi nokuxazulula ngokushesha. Isekela izinkokhelo zomuntu obonayo, e-online, nezisekelwe ezi-invoyisi nge-conversion ezenzakalelayo eya kumali yakho yendawo.
biz_wallets_meta_description: Zonke izikhwama ze-Bitcoin ziyasebenzelana — khetha esihambelana nebhizinisi lakho. Mahhala, ukuxazulula ngokushesha, akukho kubuyiselwa.
